name: United States Capitol: doors
_about: The Capitol's doors: under the east portico the Columbus Doors (Randolph Rogers, cast 1860: bronze, eight reliefs of Columbus's life in two leaves under a tympanum); in the Senate's and the House's east porticoes Crawford's bronze doors (cast 1868 and 1905); the ground-storey doors on the west terrace and at the wings' ends, panelled wood; the door from the central block to the west front's rooms.

doors._about: the Columbus Doors, the rotunda's east door
the Senate's and the House's bronze doors
the wings' end doors on the ground storey
the west front's door onto the terrace
